gap_impact.cost_economics: Incomplete if CERC tariff orders or SECI auction data missing — CAPEX estimates become indicative only. Missing KERC orders limits Karnataka cost comparison.
gap_impact.grid_access: Missing Open Access Registry data means queue wait times are estimated from regulations, not actuals. BESCOM data gap limits Karnataka grid congestion analysis.
gap_impact.subsidies_policy: Missing MNRE scheme PDFs limits subsidy amount precision — ballpark from NITI Aayog still possible. Missing KREDL data limits Karnataka scheme detail.
gap_impact.utility_standards: Missing state RPO orders (RERC/GERC/KERC) means only national targets available — state compliance gap unknown for all three states.
gap_impact.approval_signals: EIA transcripts require manual download — NLP over this dimension will be thinner than others. Pavagada land-lease model is unique unknown unknown for Karnataka.
gap_impact.unknown_unknowns: Prayas + JMK data provides reasonable national coverage. Karnataka curtailment data and Pavagada farmer-lease model are key discovery-layer findings.
